function safe(j,auth=false){function scan(v){if(!v||typeof v!=='object')return;for(const k of Object.keys(v)){if(['password','passwordHash','password_hash'].includes(k)||(!auth&&['accessToken','refreshToken'].includes(k)))throw Error('Sensitive response field '+k);scan(v[k]);}}check('No sensitive fields',()=>scan(j));}

async function login(email,password=pw,setup=true){const r=await call('POST','/auth/login',null,{email,password});if(setup&&(r.code!==200||!r.json?.accessToken||!r.json?.refreshToken))block('Login prerequisite HTTP '+r.code);if(!setup)status(r,[200],'Login succeeds');if(r.json?.refreshToken)sessions.push(r.json);return r.json;}

async function trackCreated(r,b){if(r.code>=200&&r.code<300&&b?.email?.toLowerCase().startsWith('qa19-')){let u=r.json?.user;if(!u?.id){const l=await call('GET','/admin/users?q='+encodeURIComponent(b.email)+'&limit=100',admin.accessToken);u=l.json?.data?.find(x=>x.email.toLowerCase()===b.email.toLowerCase());}if(!u?.id)throw Error('Created account has no recoverable ID: '+b.email);record({...u,email:b.email});return u;}}

async function create(role='TEACHER',extra={},setup=true){const b={fullName:'QA Regression Tester',email:'qa19-'+id+'-'+run+'-'+owned.length+'@example.com',password:pw,role,...extra};const r=await call('POST','/admin/users',admin.accessToken,b);const u=await trackCreated(r,b);if(setup&&(r.code!==201||!u?.id))block('Create fixture prerequisite HTTP '+r.code);if(!setup){status(r,[201],'Create user');safe(r.json);check('Created contract',()=>{pm.expect(u.id).to.exist;pm.expect(u.email).to.eql(b.email);pm.expect(u.role).to.eql(role);});}return{...u,...b};}
async function actor(role='TEACHER'){const u=await create(role);return{...u,...await login(u.email)};}
async function me(s){const r=await call('GET','/users/me',s.accessToken);status(r,[200],'Read profile');safe(r.json);return r.json;}
async function lock(s){const r=await call('PATCH','/admin/users/'+s.id+'/status',admin.accessToken,{status:'LOCKED'});if(r.code!==200)block('Lock fixture prerequisite HTTP '+r.code);}
async function fields(s,b){const j=await me(s);check('Persisted fields',()=>{for(const k of Object.keys(b))pm.expect(j[k],k).to.eql(b[k]);});return j;}

async function badProfile(s,b){const before=await me(s);status(await call('PUT','/users/me',s.accessToken,b),[400]);const after=await me(s);check('Profile unchanged after rejection',()=>pm.expect(after).to.deep.eql(before));}

Item request = independent admin login prerequisite. Post-response script executes all target API steps sequentially using pm.sendRequest, asserts each result and deletes only accounts created by this case. Seed IDs/emails replaced with case-owned fixtures; ADMIN remains environment-supplied.

Qase steps:
1. Đăng nhập bằng account admin seed.
Expected: HTTP 200 và nhận access token.
Data: JSON body: {"email":"hoang.thanh.ngan@utc-polyglot.edu.vn","password":"Password123!"}
2. Gửi GET /api/v1/users/me bằng access token nhận được.
Expected: HTTP 200; email là hoang.thanh.ngan@utc-polyglot.edu.vn, role là ADMIN, status là ACTIVE; không có password.
Data: Header: Authorization: Bearer <admin access token>

Qase 693
Xác nhận teacher, student và request không token không gọi được admin mutation.

Item request = independent admin login prerequisite. Post-response script executes all target API steps sequentially using pm.sendRequest, asserts each result and deletes only accounts created by this case. Seed IDs/emails replaced with case-owned fixtures; ADMIN remains environment-supplied.

Qase steps:
1. Teacher gọi PUT user ID 12.
Expected: Teacher cả ba request HTTP 403.
Data: Header: Authorization: Bearer <teacher access token> JSON body: {"fullName":"Hack"}
2. Teacher gọi PATCH status ID 12.
Expected: Student cả ba request HTTP 403.
Data: Header: Authorization: Bearer <teacher access token> JSON body: {"status":"LOCKED"}
3. Teacher gọi DELETE ID 12.
Expected: Không token cả ba request HTTP 401.
Data: Header: Authorization: Bearer <teacher access token> Không có request body.
4. Student gọi PUT, PATCH, DELETE ID 12.
Expected: Dùng token ở bước trước; không có body mới.
Data: Header: Authorization: Bearer <student access token> JSON body: {"fullName":"Hack"}
5. Không token gọi PUT, PATCH, DELETE.
Expected: Dùng token ở bước trước; không có body mới.
Data: Không gửi header Authorization. JSON body: {"fullName":"Hack"}
